# MyAibo

> MyAibo (Hilisa Ventures Pvt Ltd) is a Bengaluru-based AI marketing and technology agency offering Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), SEO, content marketing, AI automation development, white-label development, and full-stack development for brands across India and globally.

## Services

- [GEO Services](https://www.myaibo.in/solutions/geo): Generative Engine Optimization — improving brand visibility and citation share in AI-generated answers (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini).
- [AEO Services](https://www.myaibo.in/solutions/aeo): Answer Engine Optimization — structuring content to be directly surfaced as answers by AI and voice assistants.
- [SEO Services](https://www.myaibo.in/solutions/seo): Traditional search engine optimization and organic visibility.
- [Content Marketing](https://www.myaibo.in/solutions/content-marketing): Strategic content production and distribution.
- [AI Automation](https://www.myaibo.in/solutions/ai-automations): Custom AI workforce and automation development.
- [Full Stack Development](https://www.myaibo.in/solutions/full-stack): End-to-end web application and platform development.

## Case Studies

- [Transport Management System Software: Domain Authority Doubled in 9 Months](https://www.myaibo.in/case-study/tms-software-seo-domain-authority): SEO and digital PR took Domain Authority from 7 to 14 and produced 74 organic leads and 10 SQLs in one quarter.
- [Consumer Healthcare: A Gamified Kids' App Without an 18-Month ML Build](https://www.myaibo.in/case-study/consumer-healthcare-gamified-wound-care-app): A paediatric wound-care app rebuilt to ship with zero live AI calls, which took 12 to 18 months of ML work off the plan.
- [FMCG: Real-Time Sentiment on 500K+ Daily Mentions](https://www.myaibo.in/case-study/fmcg-nlp-social-listening-sentiment): An NLP social listening tool with 89% classification accuracy that cut insight-to-decision time from weeks to hours.
- [Payroll Technology: A Community Map for the Move Upmarket](https://www.myaibo.in/case-study/payroll-technology-eor-community-strategy): 100+ LinkedIn groups and Reddit communities scored to reach enterprise EOR buyers in North America.
